title: Media & Entertainment
description: Covers types of media, discussing films, music and books, giving opinions and recommendations, and key media vocabulary. For A2 completers who want to talk about their favourite entertainment in English.

content.content: {"time":1700000501000,"blocks":[{"id":"aA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Media refers to the channels through which information and entertainment are communicated to the public. At B1 level, you should know the key types of media and be able to compare them."}},{"id":"dD4eE5fF6g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Traditional media:"}},{"id":"gG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Newspapers and magazines — printed publications with news, features, and opinions","Television — broadcast programmes including news, drama, documentaries","Radio — audio broadcasts of news, music, and talk shows","Books and libraries — printed or physical knowledge resources"]}},{"id":"jJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Digital / new media:"}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Online news sites — digital versions of newspapers; updated in real time","Podcasts — on-demand audio content on any topic","Social media platforms — user-generated content shared online","Streaming services — on-demand video or music (e.g. Netflix, Spotify)","Blogs / vlogs — written or video content created by individuals"]}},{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary: broadcast, publish, subscribe, stream, audience, viewer, listener, circulation"}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000502000,"blocks":[{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Consuming news critically is an important skill. content.content: {"time":1700000504000,"blocks":[{"id":"uU6vV7wW8x","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A film review gives your opinion about a film and helps others decide whether to watch it. Good reviews describe the film's content and evaluate its quality."}},{"id":"xX9yY0zA1b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Structure of a film review:"}},{"id":"bB2cC3dD4e","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Introduction — title, director, genre, release year","Plot summary — a brief description without spoilers","Evaluation — what you liked and disliked","Recommendation — who would enjoy it and why"]}},{"id":"eE5fF6gG7h","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful language:"}},{"id":"hH8iI9jJ0k","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["The film is directed by... and stars...","It revolves around / The plot follows...","One of the highlights is... / The weakest aspect is...","The acting is outstanding / convincing / disappointing.","I would highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys...","I wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for..."]}},{"id":"kK1lL2mM3n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Adjectives for film reviews: gripping, thought-provoking, predictable, original, moving, terrifying, hilarious, slow-paced, well-crafted"}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000505000,"blocks":[{"id":"nN4oO5pP6q","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Music is a universal language, but talking about it in English requires specific vocabulary. content.content: {"time":1700000506000,"blocks":[{"id":"dD9eE0fF1g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Describing a concert or live event is a great opportunity to use past tenses, descriptive adjectives, and emotional language at B1 level."}},{"id":"gG2hH3iI4j","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary for concerts:"}},{"id":"jJ5kK6lL7m","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["venue — the place where the event is held","set list — the list of songs performed","encore — extra songs performed after the main show","crowd / audience — the people attending the event","atmosphere — the mood and feeling of the event","front row — the closest seats to the stage","to perform / to play live — to give a live performance"]}},{"id":"mM8nN9oO0p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Narrative tenses for describing events:"}},{"id":"pP1qQ2rR3s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Past simple for completed actions: The band played for two hours without a break.","Past continuous for ongoing background: Everyone was singing along by the third song.","Past perfect for earlier events: By the time we arrived, the support act had already finished."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

lessons.title: Types of Books and Literary Vocabulary

content.content: {"time":1700000507000,"blocks":[{"id":"sS4tT5uU6v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Reading books in English — or discussing books you have read — is an excellent way to develop your language skills. content.content: {"time":1700000511000,"blocks":[{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Media has a powerful influence on how people perceive the world, form opinions, and make decisions. At B1 level, you should be able to discuss this influence critically."}},{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Ways media influences society:"}},{"id":"vV2wW3xX4y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Agenda-setting — media decides which stories are important by choosing what to cover","Framing — the way a story is presented affects how audiences interpret it","Advertising — media shapes consumer behaviour and desires","Role models — celebrities and influencers affect people's lifestyles and values","Social norms — media reflects and reinforces what is considered 'normal'"]}},{"id":"yY5zA6bB7c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Discussing media influence:"}},{"id":"cC8dD9eE0f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["The media has a significant influence on...","Many people form their opinions based on what they see in the news.","Advertising can create unrealistic expectations about...","It is important to consume media critically and question what we read."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000512000,"blocks":[{"id":"fF1gG2hH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"In a world saturated with media, managing screen time and maintaining digital wellbeing has become increasingly important."}},{"id":"iI4jJ5kK6l","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key concepts:"}},{"id":"lL7mM8nN9o","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["screen time — the amount of time spent looking at screens","digital detox — a period of deliberately avoiding screens and social media","doom-scrolling — endlessly scrolling through negative news content","notification overload — receiving too many alerts from apps","media literacy — the ability to understand and evaluate media critically"]}},{"id":"oO0pP1qQ2r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Using modal verbs and conditionals for advice:"}},{"id":"rR3sS4tT5u","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["You should set limits on how much time you spend online each day.","If you find yourself doom-scrolling, you ought to take a break.","It might be worth doing a digital detox once in a while.","You could try turning off notifications to reduce distractions."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}
